this roaring waterfall gushing from its rocky crag. Plunging from level to level, it shatters into a thousand streams, and then into thousands more, sending up clouds of spray heaven high. And then, gloriously rising from this storm of commotion, the tinted arch of the rainbow’s changing permanence— now sharply etched, now melting into air— scatters fragrant showers all around. In this I see a mirror of human striving. Consider, and it’s easily understood: Life is not light, but the refracted color.

@@U02214@@
The throne room. STATE COUNCIL awaiting the EMPEROR. Trumpets. Splendidly dressed COURTIERS of every sort step forward. The EMPEROR ascends the throne, the ASTROLOGER at his right hand.

@@U02216@@
Most dear and loyal subjects, I greet you assembled here from near and far. I see my philosopher at my side, but what has happened to my Fool?

@@U02218@@
As you mounted the stairs, Sire, he collapsed just behind your trailing robe. Dead or drunk, who knows? They lugged that tub of lard away.

@@U02220@@
In the blink of an eye, Sire, another presented himself on the spot. Exquisitely dressed he may be, but he’s so grotesque he frightens everyone. He's being held at the door by guards

@@U02212@@
这座咆哮的瀑布从岩石峭壁中喷涌而出。它从一个层面跌落到另一个层面，破碎成一千条溪流，然后又变成数千条溪流，高高地喷射出云朵。然后，从这场骚乱的风暴中光荣地升起，彩虹的持久变化的彩色拱门——现在被尖锐地蚀刻，现在融化在空气中——向四周散落芬芳的阵雨。在此我看到了人类奋斗的一面镜子。想一想，这很容易理解：生命不是光，而是折射的颜色。

@@U02214@@
王座室。国务会议正在等待皇帝。小号。衣着光鲜亮丽的各个朝臣向前迈出了一步。皇帝登基，占星家在他的右手边。

@@U02216@@
最亲爱和忠诚的臣民们，我向远近聚集在这里的你们致以问候。我看到我的哲学家就在我身边，但我的愚者怎么了？

@@U02218@@
陛下，当您登上楼梯时，他就倒在您拖着的长袍后面。死了还是喝醉了，谁知道呢？他们把那桶猪油拖走了。

@@U02220@@
